profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Architect | AI Agents amp; Agentic AI | Distributed Systems | AI Platforms | Multi-Tenant Cloud | Microsoft Azure
profile.summary:
Principal-level software engineer and architect with 23+ years of experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems, AI agent platforms, and enterprise cloud services.

At Microsoft, I have architected and delivered production AI agents, including the Sales Research Agent for Copilot for Sales and an automated AI Sales Development Agent, and led architecture for a multi-tenant AI Agent Platform spanning extensibility, security boundaries, privacy, Responsible AI, and cross-organization integration.

My background combines AI platform architecture with deep distributed-systems experience. I previously architected Azure Digital Twins streaming infrastructure capable of processing 3+ billion events per day, built real-time and event-driven cloud systems, and contributed to security and identity architecture for Azure Active Directory.

Areas of expertise include:

AI Agents / Agentic AI • AI Platforms • Distributed Systems • Software Architecture • Microsoft Azure • Multi-Tenant SaaS • Event-Driven Architecture • Microservices • High-Scale Streaming • APIs • gRPC • OAuth2 • Security Architecture • Privacy • Responsible AI • Cloud Platforms • Technical Leadership.

I am particularly interested in Principal Software Engineer and Principal Engineer opportunities where I can combine hands-on technical depth, large-scale system architecture, AI-native platforms, and cross-team technical leadership.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | Architect
positions.description:
Autonomous Sales Development AI Agent

• Established the foundational architecture and runtime for the Sales Development Agent (SDA), designing and implementing the initial end-to-end steel thread across Control Plane and Data Plane services that became the basis for the platform's production architecture. 

• Oversaw the technical architecture of SDA, driving design reviews, architectural governance, and cross-team alignment to ensure feature implementations were scalable, secure, extensible, and aligned with the long-term platform vision. 

• Defined core platform patterns for agent orchestration, execution, data access, and multi-tenant service operation, enabling rapid feature development and enterprise-scale adoption. 

• Influenced technical strategy across partner organizations, aligning platform dependencies, architecture investments, and delivery plans for Microsoft 365's next-generation AI Sales Agents.


Real-Time Web Personalization (Dynamics 365 Marketing)

• Architected and delivered Microsoft's Real-Time Web Personalization platform, enabling customers to personalize digital experiences using live customer signals and behavioral data.

• Defined the technical strategy and architecture for integrating streaming, analytics, and customer data platforms into a unified personalization capability spanning multiple Dynamics 365 products.

• Led cross-organizational architecture and execution efforts across Marketing, Customer Insights, and platform engineering teams, aligning product investments and dependency roadmaps.

• Designed scalable multi-tenant services and distributed data-processing architecture supporting high-volume real-time event ingestion, customer profile enrichment, and personalization decisioning.

• Established foundational observability, reliability, and operational patterns adopted across the platform, improving service health, scalability, and engineering velocity.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Java · Platform Architecture · Software Architecture · Agentic AI Development

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Software Architect | AI & Cloud Solutions | CRM & Data Integration

Currently contributing to the development and maintenance of Tableau Prep’s customer-facing product and APIs, ensuring seamless data transformation for enterprise users.

Key Contributions:

Cross-Org Integration: Led the integration of Tableau Prep with Salesforce products, enhancing interoperability and data flow across platforms.

Scalability & Maintenance: Driving improvements in performance, reliability, and API capabilities to support business-critical workflows.


Bringing expertise in AI, cloud solutions, and enterprise software to create scalable, high-impact systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead – Azure Digital Twins PaaS

Led a team of engineers in building a highly scalable, event-driven stream processing system using Azure EventHub and Azure Service Bus.

Drove cross-team collaboration, defining product and service integrations while leading key decision-making discussions.

Designed a robust microservice hosting platform, optimizing intra-microservice communication via gRPC and HTTP.

Architected an inter-service authentication mechanism and an automated X.509 certificate rotation strategy.

Azure Active Directory (AAD) Identity Service

Contributed to the evolution of the Azure AD application model (OAuth2) within Microsoft’s Identity platform.

Provided technical support to both internal Microsoft teams and external customers.

Worked on AAD Graph and the AAD Token Service backend, integrating DevOps best practices.

Played a key role in live-site operations, ensuring and exceeding stringent SLAs for critical identity services.

Azure Incident Management System

Developed high-availability, scalable OData REST microservices.

Built an Aspect-Oriented framework for cross-cutting concerns using Unity Interception.

Established testability best practices based on the test pyramid methodology.

Designed and implemented a continuous delivery infrastructure.

Developed full-stack web applications using SQL Server, Entity Framework, ASP.NET, Web API, jQuery, KnockoutJS, and QUnit.

positions.title: SDE @ Microsoft
positions.description:
As an SDE worked in a couple of projects the first is UDI which enhances MDT (OS Deployment) adding and changing features across multiple managed and unmanaged applications. Also performed the role of SDET designing and implementing test frameworks , leveraging the MVVM pattern to automate component and acceptance tests, ensuring the convergence with acceptance criteria and meeting code coverage requirements and most important giving the team confidence of the product’s quality. 
Actively participated in product features design and development, applying programming best practices, design patterns and ensuring testability.

positions.title: Sr. Software engineer
positions.description:
As a Sr. Net agile developer participated in the development of several SOA base solutions, implementing design patterns such as Façade, Factory method, Dependency Injection MVVM, also responsible of test automation this products with the help of NUnit, Fitnesse and CodedUI, implementing test plans in MTM and implementing test fixtures to obtain an high level of quality and code coverage.

@ Microsoft Research

As an SDE in an agile team my duties consisted on globalizing, localizing and adding the ability to switch to forms authentication across the solution which included Zentity Web Portal and WCF services also creating test plans and developed the corresponding test fixtures.

positions.title: Co-Founder | Architect
positions.description:
Lead a team of engineers in the implementation of several Business to Consumer, Business to Business and ERP systems for the insurance and retail industries from ground up.

Responsabilities:

- Architecture of an insurance management system.
- Lead a team of developers.
- Define patterns and practices.
- Constant ineraction with customers.
- Project planning.
- Disaster recovery and business continuity plan.

Technical skills:
   ASP.Net
   Javascript
   SQL Server
   SQL Server replication
   SQL Mirroring
